heading: Elimination of pension offset for certain rehired Federal retirees

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Commission may waive the application of section 8344 or 8468 of title 5 on a case-by-case basis for employment of an annuitant—

children.text: in a position of the Commission for which there is exceptional difficulty in recruiting or retaining a qualified employee; or
when a temporary emergency hiring need exists.

tree.heading: Procedures
tree.text: The Commission shall prescribe procedures for the exercise of authority under this section, including—

children.text: criteria for any exercise of authority; and
procedures for a delegation of authority.

tree.heading: Effect of waiver
tree.text: An employee as to whom a waiver under this section is in effect shall not be considered an employee for purposes of subchapter II of chapter 83, or chapter 84, of title 5.

sourceCredit: (Aug. 1, 1946, ch. 724, title I, § 170C, as added Pub. L. 109–58, title VI, § 624(a), Aug. 8, 2005, 119 Stat. 783.)
